sketchup_get_resources.description: Read paged materials, tags, definitions, full native scene metadata or styles. Scene saved_properties/selected/style/timing and style active_style_changed are included. Exact names/session-local resource IDs; restart paging after edits.

sketchup_manage_resource.description: Create/update/delete solid-color materials or tags, or purge unused definitions/materials/tags. Tag deletion preserves geometry and reassigns it to Layer0. Layer0 and active tag cannot be deleted. Purge is model-wide and requires confirm_model_wide=true. No texture file access. Tags accept line_style: exact name from model_query capabilities, or null for solid line (SketchUp2019+).

ui_updates.description: Native model operations only: defer suppresses intermediate UI/Outliner updates and requests one refresh after commit/abort. normal allows normal updates. No persistent freeze/tray visibility changes. Not applicable to camera/scenes.

sketchup_component.description: Convert groups to components, explode explicit groups/components, replace component definitions, create instances of an existing definition, or update definition name/description. Definition metadata affects all occurrences. Recursive definitions and glued targets are rejected; shared edits require explicit affect_all_instances=true. Required options: convert/explode: entity_ids; replace: entity_ids,definition_id; instantiate: definition_id,origin_mm; metadata: definition_id,affect_all_instances=true plus name/description. definition_id is a model-session-local definition:<entityID> returned by get_resources/get_entity_info, not a drawing persistent ID. Query fresh after model switching.

sketchup_create_geometry.description: Create isolated geometry in a new group using model-axis mm: construction points, planar face, regular polygon, center/two-point(ends+signed bulge)/three-point arc, Bezier or freehand curve, closed oriented indexed polyhedron, convex planar polygon offset, revolution or Follow Me sweep. Precision is segments (3..128); no holes or self-intersecting profiles. See options required by each kind in docs/EXTENDED_TOOLKIT.md. Required options: points/face/freehand: points_mm; polygon: origin_mm,plane,radius_mm,sides; arc_center: origin_mm,plane,radius_mm,start_degrees,sweep_degrees; arc_two_point: points_mm=[start,end],plane,bulge_mm; arc_three_point: points_mm=[start,through,end]; bezier: points_mm(2..16 controls); polyhedron: points_mm,faces(index loops); offset: points_mm,distance_mm(positive outward); revolve: points_mm(closed profile),pivot_mm,axis,sweep_degrees; sweep: points_mm(closed profile),path_mm(start on profile plane, first segment normal). Optional segments for arcs/Bezier/revolve, default24. Mesh budget256 faces/2048 indexed corners.

sketchup_edit_geometry.description: Edit explicit raw children of one direct group/component. Unique definition required, or explicit affect_all_instances=true for shared components; this edits their definition for all occurrences. Shared groups still require make_unique. Add points/lines/faces, erase raw items, move construction points or edge endpoints, regenerate bounded faces, reverse faces, assign front/back materials, soften/smooth or unsoften edges, dissolve only coplanar internal edges. Edge deletion can remove adjacent faces. IDs/paths become stale after topology edits. No implicit edit-context changes. Required options: add_points/add_lines/add_face: points_mm; move_vertices: vertex_moves(edge_id,endpoint=start/end,position_mm); others: entity_ids. move_points also delta_mm. properties: material/back_material(null clears),hidden. soften: optional angle_degrees default30, only two-face edges within angle. simplify: only untextured matching coplanar face pairs; verifies total area. Omit container_id to edit raw geometry directly in the current edit context, including model root, without grouping. Shared edit ancestors remain rejected. Current context budget2048 direct entities.

sketchup_configure_camera.description: Set eye/target/up in model coordinates, perspective and FOV (degrees) or orthographic height (mm). Camera change has no model Undo and restores the previous camera on failure. Requires normal camera mode. aspect_ratio=0 follows viewport; otherwise0.1..10. Omitted aspect/image width retain the current values. focal_length_mm is an alternative to fov_degrees; image_width_mm is the physical film width in mm (0 means36mm, default current). No2-point perspective setter.

sketchup_scene.description: Default preserves camera-only scene behavior. options.scope=full saves/updates all2019 scene properties (camera, style/rendering, shadows, axes, combined hidden geometry/objects, layers, section planes), or selects/deletes an existing full scene. create/update may set new_name,description,transition_seconds,delay_seconds,include_in_animation. apply temporarily sets transition0, selects the native Page and restores timing; acknowledgement does not promise animation/render completion. Commit pending style edits first (style update), or on apply only explicitly discard_style_changes=true. Root only. No reliable2019 model Undo; inspect after outcome_unknown, never blindly retry.

sketchup_create_sliding_window.description: Create an optimized parametric two-panel sliding window in one typed request and one operation/Undo. Model axes: X width, Z height, Y depth. Builds frame/rails, separate sliding sashes, 6mm-default glass, beads/seals and outer-stile flush pulls; applies existing materials and removes coplanar untextured seams internally without per-face RPCs. Four groups total. Explicit replace_entity_id atomically replaces one current direct group/component. open_sash selects left/right and open_fraction0..1; none requires0. Dimensions/profile/glass clearances validated together. Fixed4s cooperative budget; no arbitrary Ruby, file I/O or implicit edit-context changes. Native UI updates deferred until completion.

sketchup_draw_geometry.description: Draw model-axis geometry. Default grouping=auto draws points, lines, faces and native curves directly in the current edit context without temporary groups; closed solids are grouped. Direct drawing can merge/split existing geometry. Refresh IDs afterward. Choose group for isolation or none to require raw geometry. Native raw circular arcs require uniform edit scaling. surface_mesh: points_mm3..256 and zero-based triangles1..256; optional smooth and existing material. Open triangle surface supported; topology/winding checked, intersections that split native faces rejected. grouping auto/none draws raw faces, group isolates. No manifold/solid claim. Probe terrain-grid example computes geometry outside RBZ.

sketchup_model_query.description: Read capabilities, bounded recursive physical metrics, ray hits, face point classification or paged custom attributes. No model changes. Metrics/classify require root edit context on2019; return model-axis mm/mm2/mm3. Repeated instances counted; overlapping solids not unioned. face_texture: instance_path only, returns both direct material sides, four UV samples and a model-mm face frame. view_state: empty options, current camera/render/shadow/layers/axes. view_presets: empty options lists names, or name returns the saved state. All three require root context. classification: empty options or offset/limit lists loaded schemas; definition_id+classification_path reads a scalar value. Missing path returns null; choice/tree values rejected. file_style_support: empty options, reports native Style APIs available on this installation and IFC option generation; translator availability/fidelity still requires real-file verification.

sketchup_entity_attributes.description: Set or delete one custom attribute on a direct drawing entity. Shared edit ancestors and locked targets are rejected. value_json is a scalar/array JSON value; object metadata can be stored as a JSON string. Uses one Undo.

sketchup_face_texture.description: Position an existing textured material on a face, using1..4 model point(mm)/UV(unitless) pairs. Root context, unique unlocked ancestors required. Uses2019 position_material overload; no deprecated projection setter. action defaults position (requires material/mapping). clear takes no material/mapping and clears only the chosen face side; inherited parent material can remain visible. For rotate/scale/tile/tilt use library authoring texture_example and a face-texture/1 read.

sketchup_texture_resource.description: Create a PNG/JPEG material or load SKM; replace_image/remove_image/set_size edit an existing named material and require affect_all_uses=true because every use is affected. copy(source_name,new name) creates an independent material with embedded pixels. tile_size_mm=[width,height] sets physical repeat size; replacement/copy retain existing dimensions when omitted. remove_image retains color/alpha. Paths required only for create_texture/load_skm/replace_image; local files <=64MiB. copy/remove/size need no source file. No image generation/network calls. File reads excluded from batches. One model Undo.

sketchup_view_preset.description: Save/delete up to16 named camera/render/shadow/layer/axes presets inside the model, or apply a saved name or explicit partial state. save/delete use model Undo; apply has no reliable model Undo and restores all captured state on failure. Root context; at most128 layers and12KB state. Layer0/active layer cannot be hidden. Does not save per-object hidden flags, section activation, named Styles or SketchUp Pages. Axes are drawing axes, not geometry transforms. Read via model_query view_state/view_presets. Excluded from typed batches.

sketchup_style.description: Load a local .style (2019 Boolean return), select an exact unique style, commit current edited style, or change name/description. options: load path,select(default false); select name; update affect_all_uses=true; metadata name,affect_all_uses=true,new_name/description. Switching with unsaved edits needs discard_style_changes=true or prior update. Affects scenes using the style. Root, dry-run, no reliable2019 Undo. No .style export/public2019 Ruby writer. purge_unused: confirm_model_wide=true, rejects pending style edits and verifies selected/scene styles remain. duplicate: name,new_name,optional select/discard_style_changes; requires native duplicate API(SU2026.2+), copies committed style only. delete: name, requires native remove_style(SU2026+) and unused/unselected/not-last style. Neither duplication nor individual deletion is available on2019. export_settings: path(.json),optional name/include_shadows, writes probe-display/1 editable rendering/shadow settings up to16KiB. import_settings: path only, strict JSON and setting validation, applies editable settings with rollback; does not create/switch/commit a Style, no watermark/image assets or full .style export. Query model_query file_style_support first.

sketchup_model_file.description: Root-only local SKP/DWG/DXF I/O, input<=64MiB. import_skp loads a definition and places one component at options.origin_mm (default0), optional name, one Undo. import_cad uses2019 Model#import (not2021.1 DefinitionList#import), native translator owns grouping/units/Undo; no atomic rollback promise. CAD needs Pro/installed translator. save_copy saves the whole model to a NEW .skp, version2019(default) or current, keeping current model path. export_cad writes whole model3D DWG/DXF with native options, no2D view exporter. All outputs are new files, no overwrite, no network, SHA256; unexpected sidecars rejected. Dry-run validates path/options only, not file content or translator fidelity. Excluded from batches. export_selection_skp: options.entity_ids1..25 root groups/components, coordinates=model(default) or first_local; copies references into a temporary wrapper, saves current SKP format and aborts/verifies cleanup before publishing. No raw face selection or version override. export_dxf2d: required plane XY/XZ/YZ, optional entity_ids(root groups/components/edges/faces), origin_mm,include_hidden,include_soft; own DXF2000 writer, projected LINEs in mm/on layer0, max5000 lines/20000 visited entities, no Pro needed, no occlusion/section clipping/perspective. import_ifc: .ifc, empty options, native Pro importer. export_ifc: whole model;2019-2025 accepts hidden_geometry,doublesided_faces,ifc_mapped_items,ifc_types(default all supported);2026+ accepts ifc_version(default IFC 2x3),standard_ifc_hierarchy,hidden_geometry,tessellated_geometry(IFC4 only). Unsupported version options rejected; no silent option loss. All file actions excluded from batches. save_copy requires the model to have been saved once in SketchUp; model_unsaved is returned before native file I/O otherwise.

sketchup_classification.description: Load .skc schema (native resource change, no Undo guarantee), or add/remove a schema_name+type_name on definition_id, or set_value using classification_path. All definition writes require affect_all_instances=true, reject locked occurrences/ancestors, use one model Undo. set_value accepts scalar string/number/boolean and checks readback; native choice attributes unsupported. Query schemas/scalar paths with model_query classification; public2019 API cannot enumerate type catalogs. load_schema options:path; add/remove:definition_id,schema_name,type_name,affect_all_instances; set_value:definition_id,classification_path,value,affect_all_instances.
